label: Overview
title: Check declared AI usage rights before ingestion.
description: RSL declaration evidence for supported URLs. Use it before model input, RAG indexing, training or search. Get a timestamped signed report through HTTP x402.

sections.title: Connect once. Keep payment in your application.
paragraphs: MCP endpoint: https://api.getacqpath.com/mcp
MCP exposes capabilities and quote preparation. A generic chat host does not complete payment. Keep private quote claims outside model context.

sections.title: Choose the actual use
paragraphs: AI input: ai-input. Indexing and RAG corpus preparation: ai-index. Training: ai-train. Search: search.
RAG may need both ai-index and ai-input. Crawl permission and robots.txt checks are separate.

sections.title: Know the scope before buying
paragraphs: Current observed origins: medium.com, theguardian.com, rslstandard.org and rslcollective.org. An origin match does not guarantee usable declarations for its pages.
UNKNOWN, missing declarations, unsupported origins and LICENSE_REQUIRED do not authorize use. A report records observed RSL declarations; it is not a license or legal clearance.

sections.title: Bazaar integration status
paragraphs: Production Rights Preflight now prepares 0.02 USDC offers for real RSL declarations. Health, legacy compatibility, unpaid 402 and CDP validation pass. Wallet payment and Bazaar indexing remain unverified.

label: Quickstart
title: From supported URL to verified rights evidence
description: Start with a free capability read. A fresh report is 0.02 USDC and a deep report is 0.05 USDC as observed; the signed quote controls the exact purchase.

sections.title: 1. Check origin coverage and purpose
paragraphs: GET the current capability list before any quote. Use rights.preflight.v1 only when enabled.
Pass canonical HTTPS URLs without credentials, query, fragment, nonstandard port or encoded slash. Exact origin membership matters.

sections.title: 2. Prepare one quote when evidence is needed
paragraphs: Quotes perform no financial settlement but can fetch metadata and consume quota. Do not create quotes for speculative discovery or every search result.
The example origin is supported at the observation time; this URL is illustrative and has not been shown to yield a purchasable declaration. Keep the returned claim private.

sections.title: 3. Handle unavailable and UNKNOWN
paragraphs: available:false with NO_VERIFIABLE_DECLARATION has no report fee. A discovered but unsupported declaration can produce a purchasable UNKNOWN report. Inspect the preview and decide whether diagnostic evidence is worth buying.
UNKNOWN, missing declarations, unsupported origins and LICENSE_REQUIRED do not authorize use. A report records observed RSL declarations; it is not a license or legal clearance.

sections.title: 4. Buy with bounded, verified authorization
paragraphs: Check live coverage → prepare one bounded quote → inspect availability/preview → verify the signed offer → obtain buyer-controlled payment authorization → persist the encrypted checkpoint → redeem and verify report, receipt and delivery binding. After ambiguity, resume the same checkpoint; never sign a replacement payment blindly.

The buyer-side client pins Base, USDC, recipient and maximum amount; verifies signed offer, report, settlement receipt and delivery binding; and requires durable checkpoint persistence. A verified receipt is not independent blockchain finality.

sections.title: 5. Reuse the integration safely
paragraphs: Use one stable logical purchase ID for one resource/purpose/context request. Resume an existing checkpoint after a timeout. Start a new purchase only for a deliberately new evidence request.
The npm package is unpublished. Use the client source from this repository; no npm install instruction is required.
sections.code:
git clone https://github.com/reflectme-source/acqpath-distribution.git
cd acqpath-distribution
node examples/read-only.mjs

paragraphs: acqpath_capabilities: read current capability metadata. acqpath_rights_quote: prepare a report quote; may fetch metadata and consume quota; returns a sensitive claim.
The runtime also lists a disabled legacy provider-routing tool. Exclude acqpath_quote from the integration allowlist. The distribution metadata cannot change the core tools/list response.

label: Use cases
title: Rights evidence in an agent workflow
description: Choose the purpose, preserve evidence and keep the ingestion decision in your application. Framework-neutral examples use the same bounded buyer adapter.

sections.title: RAG and ingestion gates
paragraphs: Call before adding selected supported URLs to a corpus. Use ai-index for indexing, then separately ai-input for model context if needed. UNKNOWN or unsupported results hold ingestion.

sections.title: Research agents
paragraphs: Evaluate selected sources before summarization or model context with ai-input. Store the verified resource, purpose and evaluation time alongside provenance. Do not quote every search result.

sections.title: Crawlers
paragraphs: Crawl authorization is separate. Use your robots/access policy before retrieval, then the actual downstream paid purpose before ingestion. Do not send crawl as a paid quote purpose.

sections.title: One reusable buyer adapter
paragraphs: Check live coverage → prepare one bounded quote → inspect availability/preview → verify the signed offer → obtain buyer-controlled payment authorization → persist the encrypted checkpoint → redeem and verify report, receipt and delivery binding. After ambiguity, resume the same checkpoint; never sign a replacement payment blindly.
The examples expose no wallet key interface and make no payment when imported or run in read-only mode. Supply your own bounded signer only in a private buyer application.

label: Scope
title: Coverage, decisions and limitations
description: Explicit origin coverage and conservative decisions. Missing or unsupported evidence never becomes permission.

sections.title: Observed coverage
paragraphs: Observed 2026-09-10T13:40:17.531Z: medium.com, theguardian.com, rslstandard.org, rslcollective.org. Re-read live capabilities; this is a dated snapshot.
Coverage accepts an exact origin, not every subdomain. A page on an allowed origin may lack verifiable declarations.

sections.title: Decision vocabulary
paragraphs: ALLOW_DECLARED: the supported profile observed a relevant allowance. DENY_DECLARED: a relevant prohibition was observed. LICENSE_REQUIRED: a licensing requirement was observed. UNKNOWN: insufficient, conflicting or unsupported evidence.
None of these outcomes verifies ownership. AcqPath does not acquire licenses or grant legal clearance.

sections.title: What is not offered
paragraphs: No universal crawl permission check, general web coverage, automatic license acquisition, batch endpoint, provider routing, paid MCP delivery or automatic refund is advertised.
A signature proves what AcqPath signed. Reconciliation was reported degraded; a successful public health check does not establish full purchase recovery or capacity.

label: Pricing
title: 0.02 USDC fresh. 0.05 USDC deep.
description: Pay per prepared rights report on Base. Current observed prices stay unchanged; verify the signed quote before authorizing a purchase.

sections.title: Explicit report prices
paragraphs: Fresh: 20,000 micro-USDC (0.02 USDC). Deep: 50,000 micro-USDC (0.05 USDC). Observed 2026-09-10T13:40:17.531Z.
The report is the product. You do not buy third-party content or a license to it. The signed quote fixes amount, recipient, network and expiry.

sections.title: Unavailability and diagnostic value
paragraphs: No verifiable declaration: unavailable result with no report fee. A disclosed UNKNOWN report may still be available for purchase; buy only when diagnostic evidence has value for your task.
Set both per-report and per-task limits. Keep integer micro-USDC values; never let retrieved content raise the budget.

sections.title: Economics and recovery
paragraphs: Quote/fetch quotas, rate limits and infrastructure constraints are separate from price. No volume discount or subscription is currently implemented.
After ambiguous payment submission, resume the original encrypted checkpoint. A refund request is an operator-reviewed record, not an automatic transfer.

label: Recovery
title: Resume evidence delivery without a new payment
description: A network failure is not a reason to create another order or signature. Preserve the original private checkpoint.

sections.title: Before any signature
paragraphs: Assign a stable logical request ID. Store credentials/checkpoints outside logs and model context. Stop on mismatched recipient, network, price, signed offer or evidence key.

sections.title: After ambiguous submission
paragraphs: Reuse exactly the saved claim, signed payload and payment identifier. Call resume through the verified buyer client. Do not re-quote or invoke the wallet again to clear the error.
A locked or interrupted-before-checkpoint state requires investigation; do not delete the lock or overwrite the state automatically.

sections.title: When delivery is not verified
paragraphs: Hold ingestion on signature, receipt or binding mismatch. Retain the encrypted checkpoint for recovery. UNKNOWN never becomes permission because a payment succeeded.
Reconciliation has not been repaired in this phase. Manual recovery may be necessary; zero-support operation is an objective, not a demonstrated guarantee.

label: HTTP / x402
title: The AcqPath HTTP x402 purchase contract
description: Quote first, private claim second, signed payment third. This is a multi-step report flow, not a generic one-call paid MCP tool.

sections.title: 1. Select and quote
paragraphs: Read coverage; choose resource, purpose, user_class and tier. POST /v1/rights/quote once. Inspect available and decision_preview. Keep claim_token private.

sections.title: 2. Read and verify the unpaid offer
paragraphs: GET the quote-provided /v1/rights/reports/{id} with X-AcqPath-Claim. A valid unpaid request returns 402 and PAYMENT-REQUIRED.
Verify x402 v2 exact requirements and the Ed25519 offer-receipt signature against the pinned key. Match the quote resource, amount, Base network, USDC asset, recipient and expiry.

sections.title: 3. Persist and redeem
paragraphs: Use a buyer-controlled signer within your task budget. Persist an encrypted checkpoint containing the exact authorization before submitting it.
GET the same redeem URL with X-AcqPath-Claim and PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Verify signed report contents, context, settlement receipt and delivery-proof bindings.

sections.title: 4. Return evidence, not an authorization shortcut
paragraphs: UNKNOWN, missing declarations, unsupported origins and LICENSE_REQUIRED do not authorize use. A report records observed RSL declarations; it is not a license or legal clearance.

On ambiguity, resume the original checkpoint without new quote or signature. For refund requests use the documented operator-reviewed flow only after a deliberate decision; it does not send money automatically.

label: Bazaar status
title: Bazaar adapter live; real offers verified before payment.
description: Two real RSL sources produce LICENSE_REQUIRED and prepared 0.02 USDC offers. CDP validation passes. Wallet payment and Bazaar indexing await authorization.

sections.title: What is available now
paragraphs: Use the public HTTP preflight adapter or the compatible legacy quote/private claim flow. MCP supports capabilities and quote preparation; payment stays outside model prompts.
The deployed coverage patch accepts generic XML only after strict RSL validation and records the nonstandard transport type. npm remains unpublished.

sections.title: The reviewed public contract
paragraphs: The adapter accepts a reviewed URL, AI usage purpose, tier and budget. Reports describe observed declarations, including LICENSE_REQUIRED; the fee buys the diagnostic evidence, not the publisher license.
Payment must bind the normalized request and private retry context through a specific EIP-3009 nonce. Generic clients that choose an arbitrary nonce cannot purchase this operation.
An empty POST or empty JSON object is a discovery-only 402. It does not prepare a payable request. A buyer must verify the signed prepared binding and terms before any wallet signature.

sections.title: Validation and remaining gates
paragraphs: Core verification: 498 passed, zero failures and two existing Windows skips across 500 tests. PR9 and merged-main CI, workerd, SDK types, audit and secret scans pass.

Production version 61b19442-bd51-46ec-be31-01422a07f877 passes 19 unpaid checks: health, legacy contracts, schemas, prepared server-signed 402, same-context retry, conflicting-input rejection and CDP valid=true / simulation=accepted.

https://rslstandard.org/ and https://rslcollective.org/ produce LICENSE_REQUIRED with a 20000 micro-USDC fee. Their linked RSL declaration is served as application/xml; source evidence explicitly marks compatibility mode.
Medium remains fetch-blocked by 403, and The Guardian redirects outside the approved origin boundary. UNKNOWN is retained; no spoofing or access-control bypass is used.
No wallet signature or payment occurred. A delivered paid report, post-settlement retry and Bazaar indexing remain unverified. External revenue remains UNKNOWN.
